title: Ordinary coefficient inclusion is the tensor-transitivity adjunction mate
statement: With the explicit constructions of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-coefficient-complex-diagram], for a scheme X, prime ℓ, finite coefficient fields E,F,G with E≤G and F≤G, and any cochain complex C of F_X-modules, coefficientComplexTransposedMap(X,ℓ,he,hf,C) equals coefficientComplexToAlgCl(X,ℓ,he,hf,C). The left map is obtained using the ordinary extension/restriction adjunctions, their counit, and the ordinary coefficient tensor-transitivity isomorphisms; the right map is the explicit coefficient-inclusion map. This is an equality of actual complex morphisms before localization.

source.place: ExtendScalars and Constructible sections (boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsSubfield_obj, boundedConstructible_derivedExtendScalarsToPadicAlgCl_obj), and TwoColimit section (constructibleCocone_essSurjObj, constructibleCocone_homSurj, constructibleCocone_homInj, constructibleCocone_isFilteredTwoColimit); these are unproved upstream inputs

proof.text: Uniqueness of left adjoints gives the unit equations for the tensor-transitivity comparisons. Derive these equations from unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app and the identity underlying the restriction comparison isomorphisms.

Expand the outer mate by its unit, use tensor transitivity on E and naturality of the G→Ω unit, and apply the finite-adjunction triangle identity. The result is the G→Ω unit on the F→G extension followed by the tensor-transitivity comparison for F.

Its composite with the F→G unit is the F→Ω unit. The extension adjunction universal property identifies this map with mixedScalarMap. Apply the equality in every degree; hom_ext for complexes finishes.
